title: Purify Before You Align: Improving Representation Alignment for Diffusion Models
title_zh: 在对齐之前先净化：提升扩散模型的代表性对齐

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种名为局部外观净化（LAP）的方法，以提升扩散模型的生成质量。 Representation alignment improves and accelerates diffusion training by encouraging intermediate features to match a pretrained visual encoder. However, standard alignment matches pretrained representations without distinguishing what information may be more useful for generation. We introduce local appearance purification (LAP), which improves generation quality and makes encoders such as MAE more effective alignment targets by removing locally predictable content and aligning to the residual. LAP modifies only the alignment target, and requires no changes to diffusion training or inference. Through controlled interventions within a fixed encoder, we show that effective alignment depends on what information the target emphasizes, not simply how much image information it contains. Our theory gives a variational interpretation of standard alignment and, for fixed local predictors, a sum of token-wise information bounds conditioned on local appearance. To understand why purification benefits some encoders more than others, we derive an exact constant-readout test that measures how well the target can be matched without using the diffusion model's hidden state. LAP improves generation quality across five pretrained representations (MAE, AIMv2, CLIP, DINOv2, DINOv3), with the largest gain for MAE: on ImageNet-256 with SiT-B/2, it reduces FID from $53.1$ to $42.3$. Its gains persist with stronger alignment recipes and tokenizers. Computed before diffusion training, the constant-readout score predicts the benefit of purification (Spearman $ρ=0.94$ across 13 encoders).
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种名为局部外观净化（LAP）的方法，以提升扩散模型的生成质量。 表示对齐通过促使中间特征匹配预训练视觉编码器，从而改进并加速扩散训练。 然而，标准的对齐只是匹配预训练表示，而不区分哪些信息可能对生成更有用。 我们提出局部外观净化（LAP），该方法通过去除局部可预测的内容并对齐到剩余部分，提升生成质量，并使 MAE 等编码器成为更有效的对齐目标。 LAP 仅修改对齐目标，无需对扩散训练或推理做任何更改。 通过在固定编码器内进行受控干预，我们表明有效的对齐取决于目标强调什么信息，而不是简单地取决于它包含多少图像信息。 我们的理论给出了标准对齐的变分解释，并且在固定局部预测器的情况下，给出了以局部外观为条件的逐词元信息界的总和。 为了理解为什么净化对某些编码器的收益大于其他编码器，我们推导出一个精确的常数读取测试，用于衡量目标在不使用扩散模型隐藏状态的情况下能被匹配到何种程度。 LAP 在五种预训练表示（MAE、AIMv2、CLIP、DINOv2、DINOv3）上都提升了生成质量，其中对 MAE 的提升最大：在使用 SiT-B/2 的 ImageNet-256 上，它将 FID 从 $53.1$ 降至 $42.3$。 在更强的对齐方案和分词器下，其收益依然存在。 在扩散训练前计算的常数读取分数可以预测净化的收益（在 13 个编码器上 Spearman $ρ=0.94$）。
